title: A locally integrable function with vanishing weak coordinate derivatives on a ball is a.e. constant there
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let θ : ℝⁿ → ℝ be locally Lⁿ-integrable, x₀ ∈ ℝⁿ and ρ > 0. Assume ∫_{ℝⁿ} θ(x) D_j a(x) dLⁿ(x) = 0 for every C^∞ compactly supported a : ℝⁿ → ℝ with spt a ⊆ B_ρ(x₀) and every j ∈ {1,…,n}. Here D_j a(x) := Da(x)(e_j), e_j = EuclideanSpace.single j 1 is the j-th standard basis vector, and spt a is the closed support, the closure of {a ≠ 0} (Lean: tsupport a). Then there is c ∈ ℝ with θ(x) = c for Lⁿ-a.e. x ∈ B_ρ(x₀).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (θ : Eucl n → ℝ), LocallyIntegrable θ volume → ∀ (x₀ : Eucl n) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → (∀ a : Eucl n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) a → HasCompactSupport a → tsupport a ⊆ ball x₀ ρ → ∀ j : Fin n, ∫ x, θ x * fderiv ℝ a x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) ∂volume = 0) → ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict (ball x₀ ρ), θ x = c
